body.message:
Good Morning Mrs Zahra,

We truly appreciate your understanding and your continued stay with us over the past two years. We sincerely apologize, however, we will not be able to extend the booking for the additional 2 nights free of charge.

As our monthly bookings are calculated strictly based on 30-night periods, any extra nights beyond the confirmed stay will be subject to additional charges.

We appreciate your kind understanding and will be happy to assist with the extension upon payment of the applicable charges.

Thank you for your cooperation.
